title: Dragon Ball (anime)
blurb: 659 episodes in broadcast order, Dragon Ball through Daima; Kai is one optional row.
notes: Z and Super are split into the saga groupings their episode lists use — the season sets. Dragon Ball and GT keep one section per series, saga boundaries in the section intro.
A re-cut of Z, not a new story: 291 episodes down to 159 in Japan, 167 internationally. One optional row stands in for the whole thing.
The theatrical films and TV specials — GT's A Hero's Legacy included — are left out. They are a later page.
Through Daima (2024–25), the newest series. If a new one airs, rerun the generator.

Episode counts, years and saga groupings machine-read from Wikipedia's episode lists for Dragon Ball, Z, GT, Super and Kai and from the Dragon Ball Daima article; every total is asserted against the articles' own — lead counts, series-overview sums and the counted episode rows — before this builds. Z's check is its lead total against its overview sum, because its per-episode tables live in nine season articles this does not read.

sections.title: Dragon Ball
sections.intro: Nine sagas: Emperor Pilaf (1–13), Tournament (14–28), Red Ribbon Army (29–45), General Blue (46–57), Commander Red (58–68), Fortuneteller Baba (69–83), Tien Shinhan (84–101), King Piccolo (102–122), Piccolo Jr. (123–153).
